title: Mobility Equipment Retail Terms — Delivery Fee on a Cash-Sale Chair with Drive-System Warranty Work
content:
# Delivery Fee on a Cash-Sale Chair Given Back — Mobility Equipment

**Term.** On a Mobility Equipment chair sold for cash and given back, the delivery fee on the sale line is treated according to the chair's drive-system warranty work. When at least one joystick-and-controller or motor-and-gearbox job is posted on the chair under the manufacturer's warranty:

- when the return was requested no more than 7 days after the delivery date, the delivery fee on the sale line is refunded in full;
- when it was requested later, the delivery fee is refunded in proportion to the return-window days left: the fee multiplied by the class's self-pay return window in days less the days to the return request, divided by the class's return window in days, rounded to the cent half up.

Without such a job the delivery fee is not refunded.

**Days to the return request.** They run from the delivery date to the requested date of the chair's latest return-pickup request, or to the booking day when there is none.

## Decision table

| Warranty joystick-and-controller or motor-and-gearbox job on the chair | Days to the return request | Delivery fee refunded |
|---|---|---|
| at least one | 7 or fewer | in full |
| at least one | 8 or more | in proportion to the return-window days left |
| none | any | none |

## Worked examples (hypothetical: delivery fee 149.00, return window 14 days, one warranty controller job)

- Return requested 7 days after delivery: 149.00 refunded in full.
- Requested 8 days after delivery: 149.00 multiplied by 6 (14 less 8) and divided by 14 is 63.857, rounded half up to 63.86.
- Requested 10 days after delivery: 149.00 multiplied by 4 and divided by 14 is 42.571, rounded half up to 42.57.
- The same chair with only a battery-set warranty job: the delivery fee is not refunded.
